Preserve the aggregate in audit; split/reconcile actual incidents before publication. The Guangxi incident's precise UTC timing remains unestablished.

changes.description: Reports published August 19 combined five deaths in an August 17 Guangxi construction-site landslide with five deaths in an August 18 banquet-wall collapse in Changning, Sichuan. The combined ten is not an August 19 single-event toll.

key.title: Fire in commercial building in Qinhuangdao kills eight

records.note: The 03:40 CST August 20 fire occurred August 19 UTC. Both accounts report eight killed and three injured; cause was being investigated.

changes.description: A fire broke out in a ground-floor commercial property in Haigang district, Qinhuangdao, at about 03:40 local time on August 20. Eight people were killed and three injured. The fire was extinguished and its cause was under investigation.

key.title: Charter plane crash in western Alaska kills all eight on board

records.note: Eight aboard died near Cape Newenham on August 20; reported 12:15 Alaska daylight time is 20:15 UTC the same day. Later reporting describes a second landing approach in fog, without establishing a final cause.

key.title: Gang attack on Kenscoff community in Haiti kills at least 20

records.note: Reuters places onset at 22:30 August 23 local (02:30 UTC August 24); RNDDH says approximately 22:00, same UTC date. AP August 30 reports at least 47, superseding initial 20/30/42. RNDDH September 16 total 164 covers TWO massacres in July and August, with no separately stated complete August total; do not add it or assign all 164 here. Preserve the dated 47 minimum, not a final count.

changes.title: Gang attack on Kenscoff in Haiti kills at least 47
changes.description: Armed gangs attacked Kenscoff late on August 23 local time, killing residents, burning homes and attacking a church sheltering displaced people. AP reported at least 47 deaths by August 30. The final incident-specific toll remained uncertain.

key.title: Montana man kills eight relatives at family dinner then dies by suicide

records.note: Nine total includes eight homicide victims and the attacker. Sunday was August 23, not August 24; shortly after 18:00 MDT corresponds to August 24 UTC, so the stored date remains correct but prose must distinguish local time. Remove unsupported caller age and police attribution of the move-out motive.

changes.title: Montana man kills eight relatives and himself at family dinner
changes.description: A man killed eight relatives, including four children, at a family home outside Billings on Sunday evening, August 23 local time, before dying by suicide. Police responded shortly after 18:00, and the house caught fire. Nine people died, including the attacker.

key.title: Himalayan glacier collapse triggers catastrophic flood in Nepal and Tibet killing at least 1,420

records.note: Reuters September 15 gives 1,386 Nepal + 43 China = 1,429, not 1,420; later AFP/AP reporting September 17 gives 1,403 Nepal + 43 China = 1,446. Missing are separate: 6,150 Nepal + 519 China = 6,669, not deaths. Approximate 08:40 NPT August 26 onset is August 26 UTC. This is ONE transboundary disaster: downstream recoveries and tunnel recoveries are included, not additional events. The earlier Rolpa August 12 landslide is temporally distinct. AP climate page initially failed open but was retrieved via search; climate contribution is probabilistic. Remove unsupported exact altitude, rescue total and superseded tally chronology.

changes.title: Ice-rock avalanche triggers Nepal-Tibet flood killing at least 1,446
changes.description: An ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border triggered a destructive flood through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors on August 26. Reporting by September 17 put recovered deaths at 1,403 in Nepal and 43 in China, a combined 1,446. Another 6,669 people were reported missing across both countries, separately from the death toll. Scientific analysis indicated warming likely contributed to slope instability.

key.title: Russian drone strike on ammunition warehouse near Kyiv kills 38

records.note: Strike around 20:10 EEST August 28 supports same UTC date. Official August 30 update gives 38 dead and 20 injured, not more than 40 injured; earlier and other reports vary. Four missing are not added to deaths. Omit comparative superlative.

changes.location: Myla, Bucha district, Kyiv region, Ukraine
changes.description: A Russian drone strike hit an ammunition storage site in Myla on the evening of August 28, triggering explosions and fires in nearby buildings. President Zelenskyy reported 38 deaths and 20 injuries on August 30, with four people still missing. Authorities opened an inquiry into the storage arrangements.

key.title: Church minibus collision in central Zimbabwe kills 27

records.note: Police reporting supports 27 deaths in the minibus/truck collision near Chivhu at approximately 20:30 CAT August 28, or 18:30 UTC. August 29 is the announcement date, correctly distinguished in the description.

key.title: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza and three in West Bank

records.note: AP supports the eight-person aggregate across two territories; WAFA independently dates Jenin's three deaths to Friday evening August 28. These are distinct from August 31 Gaza deaths.

key.title: Israeli strikes kill at least five across the Gaza Strip

records.note: Both wires report at least five killed Monday August 31. Reuters URL retains an initial two-death slug but updated article reports five; do not treat the slug as the final toll.

key.title: Suspected PDF fighters kill 12 civilians in Mahlaing Township, Myanmar

records.note: Approximately 04:00 MMT August 31 is August 30 UTC. ACLED describes an unidentified armed group and victims including administrators/security-team or militia leaders assumed unarmed; military media blame PDF. Do not silently endorse either perpetrator identity or civilian status. IOM URL is a country feed, not a stable individual source record; Myawady open failed although search retrieved its text. Corroboration and victim status remain insufficient for publication.

changes.title: Twelve killed in attack on Hta Man Gyi village, Myanmar
changes.description: Twelve people were reported killed in Hta Man Gyi village, Mahlaing Township, around 04:00 local time on August 31. Myanmar military media blamed PDF fighters; independent event coding identified the attackers only as an unidentified armed group and included local administrative and security figures among the victims.

key.title: US airstrikes on IRGC targets in Iran kill five

records.note: CENTCOM confirms operations, not five Kermanshah deaths. Anadolu September 2 attributes FOUR Aerospace Force deaths to the provincial IRGC, separately three Basij on Lavan Island. No corroborated five-person Kermanshah total found. The exact Kermanshah strike time/date within the September 1-2 attacks is not established. Do not merge wedding casualties or Lavan deaths.

changes.title: US strike reportedly kills four IRGC members in Kermanshah
changes.description: Iran's provincial IRGC reported four Aerospace Force members killed in a US strike in Kermanshah, according to September 2 reporting. The precise UTC date remains unestablished; the casualty claim came from Iranian authorities, not CENTCOM.

key.title: US airstrike on wedding party in Hormozgan province kills five

records.note: Later on-scene reporting identifies four initially dead and a fifth woman dying September 3; five total supported. Injuries reported as 68 or more than 60, not established 63. Tuesday evening September 1 supports UTC date. Vance's September 3 statement concerned investigation, not an outcome finding. Two AP documents share publisher/provenance; Anadolu separately reports Iranian figures.

changes.description: A US strike hit a home hosting a wedding celebration in Kuhestak on the evening of September 1, according to Iranian authorities and AP's subsequent on-scene reporting. Five people died, including a woman who died in hospital September 3, and more than 60 were injured. Vice President JD Vance said September 3 that the US was investigating.

key.title: Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv kill at least 12

records.note: Twelve deaths including an Indian national are supported, but the attack ran more than 12 hours overnight August 31-September 1 and into Tuesday. Fatal incident times were not established sufficiently to assign all twelve to September 1 UTC. The publication date cannot resolve the mixed interval.

key.title: Bus crash in South Sinai, Egypt, kills at least 22

records.note: Updated ministry reporting supports 22 dead, including ten Jordanians, and 28 injured in Wednesday morning crash. Earlier reports of 16/17/21 deaths were preliminary; source URL slug is not the updated count.

key.title: Head-on collision between minivans in Accra kills 13

records.note: Thirteen deaths and September 2 supported. GBC initially gave five survivors; fire-service reporting gives 18 injured and describes a front-to-side impact, not simply head-on. Remove uncertain injury total and collision geometry. Ghana local date is UTC.

changes.title: Minivan collision on Sege highway in Ghana kills 13
changes.description: A collision involving two passenger minivans on the Sege section of the Accra-Aflao highway killed 13 people on September 2. Others were injured, according to Ghanaian news reports quoting emergency personnel.

key.title: Mass shooting at Loring Park in Minneapolis kills three

records.note: Shooting occurred at Shoreline Plaza apartment building in the Loring Park neighborhood, not in the park itself. Approximately 16:30 CDT is September 2 UTC. Six injured includes three civilians and three officers, one officer not shot. Follow-up establishes police killed attacker.

changes.title: Minneapolis apartment shooting leaves three dead, including attacker
changes.description: A gunman killed two people at an apartment building in Minneapolis's Loring Park neighborhood on September 2 before police shot and killed him. Three civilians and three officers were injured; two of the officers suffered gunshot wounds.

key.title: Fuel siphoning deaths in Rivers State, Nigeria, reach 43

records.note: Channels gives approximately 00:00 WAT September 3, which is September 2 UTC. Anadolu reports 43 dead but Vanguard calls 43 feared dead and later AP reports at least 37. Reports also differ on loading vessel versus tapped pipeline; some victims reportedly drowned after inhalation. No reconciled confirmed 43-person toll retrieved.

changes.description: Dozens of people reportedly died during an alleged petroleum-siphoning attempt at Okari Jetty, Okrika, around midnight at the start of September 3 local time. Reports describe toxic-fume exposure and some drownings, but differ between at least 37 deaths and 43 dead or feared dead.

key.title: Fire at wedding party in Kinshasa kills at least 12

records.note: Friday September 4 evening supports same UTC date in Kinshasa. National government's 12 differs from mayor's initial 22 and later 14; September 9 crisis-commission account maintains 12. Attribute the official count rather than presenting all reports as agreed. Cause remained under investigation.

changes.description: A fire broke out during a wedding reception at the Panacee hall in Lingwala, Kinshasa, on the evening of September 4. The government's subsequent official account reported 12 deaths, lower than initial local estimates of 22. Investigators were still determining the cause.

key.title: Explosion at military base in Viacha, Bolivia, kills nine

records.note: September 4 approximately 14:30 Bolivia time is 18:30 UTC. Nine confirmed by September 8, not established September 7; five missing must not be added despite commentary treating all 14 as dead. Injury totals evolved to 84. Source evidence does not establish the exact stored material or attack hypothesis as an outcome; omit speculative attribution.

changes.description: Explosions struck the Bolivar military regiment in Viacha on the afternoon of September 4. Authorities confirmed nine deaths by September 8, with five people still missing, and later reported 84 injured. The cause remained under investigation.

key.title: Pakistani security forces kill 48 separatists in Balochistan raids

records.note: The military's 48 is a multi-raid total over 72 hours ending September 4, not 48 deaths on that date. Geo identifies six in Mastung September 4, with other operations on earlier dates. Incident-specific dates/UTC and allocation are needed before publication as daily events; reporting does not independently establish military claims about all victims.

changes.description: Pakistan's military announced September 4 that its forces had killed 48 alleged militants during several raids in Balochistan over the preceding 72 hours. This is an attributed operational aggregate, not a September 4 single-day death toll.

key.title: Bus crash on Fogo island, Cape Verde, kills at least 25

records.note: Vatican News places crash late afternoon September 5, same UTC date; AP agrees Saturday. One secondary Brazilian report says overnight September 5-6, contrary to nearer reporting. Twenty-five deaths retained in September 15 follow-up. Omit unsupported claim that passengers were mostly secondary-school students.

changes.description: A passenger bus left a mountain road between Cha das Caldeiras and Campanas de Cima on Fogo island late on September 5, killing 25 people and injuring 14. Many victims were children and adolescents.

key.title: Fireworks explosion at religious celebration in Temascalcingo, Mexico, kills 10

records.note: Approximately 21:00-21:30 CST September 5 is September 6 UTC. Ten deaths/64 injuries supported. Cause was under investigation, so remove definitive 'accidental'.

changes.description: Fireworks exploded beside the Nuestra Senora de la Luz church in Santa Maria Canchesda, Temascalcingo, during a religious celebration on the night of September 5 local time. Ten people were killed and 64 injured. The cause was under investigation.

key.title: Fuel tanker explosion on Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, Iran, kills 11

records.note: September 5 crash and later 11 dead/7 injured supported; initial Reuters 10 was preliminary. Apparent brake failure is an attributed preliminary explanation, not a completed investigation finding.

key.title: Hostel building collapse in New Delhi kills seven

records.note: The collapse was Sunday afternoon September 6, not September 5; same UTC date. Seven dead by September 7 and twelve rescued supported.

changes.description: A five-storey building housing a private hostel collapsed in Satya Niketan on the afternoon of September 6. The death toll reached seven by September 7, and twelve people were rescued and taken to hospital.

key.title: Mudslide in Suichuan County, Jiangxi, kills 16

records.note: 04:00 CST September 5 is September 4 UTC. Thirteen belongs to the Gaoping/Mingkeng mudslide;16 is cumulative across three Suichuan towns, not an increase to 16 at this village. Keep this record's specific identity and use 13; do not add the countywide 16 to it. Preliminary missing counts varied 11/12 before recovery completed.

changes.title: Mudslide in Mingkeng village, Jiangxi, kills 13
changes.description: A mudslide struck Mingkeng village in Gaoping, Suichuan County, around 04:00 local time on September 5 after prolonged rain associated with Typhoon Saudel. Thirteen people died in this mudslide. The separate countywide total of 16 included deaths in two other towns.

key.title: Cargo plane crash at Miami airport kills five

records.note: September 6 approximately 14:00 EDT equals 18:00 UTC. Five dead were in a vehicle struck by the aircraft, not necessarily aircraft occupants; original wording does not misstate that scope. Five injuries and operator/aircraft identity supported; final cause remains unassigned.

key.title: Avalanche on Mount Mizhirgi, Russia, kills 13 climbers

records.note: Approximately 17:00 MSK September 6 is 14:00 UTC. Final recovery September 13 brought deaths to 17; federation September 17 confirms 17. Six missing belongs to earlier 11-death stage and is no longer current. Six survivors hospitalized, ten descended independently.

changes.title: Avalanche on Mount Mizhirgi, Russia, kills 17 climbers
changes.description: An avalanche hit a group of 33 climbers on Mount Mizhirgi in the Bezengi Gorge on September 6. Search teams recovered the final missing person on September 13, bringing the death toll to 17. Sixteen survived, including six who were hospitalized.

key.title: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon kill 11, including children and medics

records.note: Al-Monitor September 14 is republication: Reuters dateline/photo September 7; MarketScreener explicitly shows September 7 publication and September 14 modification. NOT a new September 14 attack. Updated ministry toll 13 comprises 12 in building, including 6 children/3 women, plus ONE medic killed and 2 medics wounded; original two-medic-death wording is superseded. Earlier AP 12 and WAFA 11 are preliminary. Reuters contains contradictory timing cues: state media 'after midnight' versus witnesses preparing for school; exact UTC date September 6/7 remains unresolved. Two Reuters URLs share one wire report.

changes.title: Israeli strikes on Kfar Rumman kill 13, including children and a medic
changes.description: Israeli strikes on a residential building and a vehicle in Kfar Rumman were reported on September 7. Lebanon's Health Ministry later reported 13 deaths: twelve in the building, including six children, and one medic in the vehicle strike. Two other medics were wounded. The precise UTC date remains unestablished.

key.title: Saudi airstrike on prison in Al-Jawf, Yemen, kills 17

sources.name: Yemeni Center for Rehabilitation of Victims of Violations and Torture

records.note: AP September 9 reports 23 recovered deaths, superseding 17; these are updates to the September 7 prison incident. Houthi authorities blame Saudi-led airstrikes; the Yemeni rights centre blames the Houthis. Do not state Saudi responsibility as undisputed. Exact strike time/UTC boundary was not established. Two AP documents share publisher and Houthi-source provenance.

changes.title: Blast at Al-Hazm prison in Yemen reportedly kills 23
changes.description: A blast destroyed a prison in Al-Hazm on September 7 local time. AP reported 23 recovered deaths by September 9. Houthi authorities attributed the destruction to Saudi-led airstrikes, while a Yemeni rights group blamed the Houthis; responsibility remains disputed.
sources: Yemeni Center for Rehabilitation of Victims of Violations and Torture

key.title: Death toll in Yemen offensive reaches 500

records.note: Components 278+216+29 equal 523, not 500. AFP says MORE THAN 500 and attributes figures to unnamed military/medical sources, not a universally confirmed total. Multi-day offensive since the previous week; September 8 is report date, not date of 523 deaths. Reconcile possible overlap with Al-Jawf prison and other Yemen strikes before integration. Arabic liveblog repeats AFP rather than independently verifies counts.

changes.title: AFP sources report more than 500 deaths in renewed Yemen fighting
changes.description: AFP reported on September 8 that military and medical sources counted at least 278 Houthi fighters,216 government troops and 29 civilians killed since renewed fighting began the previous week. Their components total 523; this is a cumulative attributed figure, not a single-day toll.

key.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv and Kyiv region kill seven

records.note: City government confirms five killed in September 8 attacks; UATV separately reports two in Kyiv region. Injury counts differ 23/29/35 and need not be retained. Strikes spanned Monday night and Tuesday; exact fatal-incident UTC dates unestablished. Sept 10 two-death Kyiv record may be an earlier bulletin from this attack; do not add without resolving identity.

changes.description: Russian strikes reported overnight and during September 8 killed five people in Kyiv and two in the surrounding region, according to Ukrainian authorities. The attacks damaged warehouses and other civilian buildings. Fatal incident times remain insufficiently resolved for a single UTC date.

key.title: Drone strike near courthouse in Umm Ruwaba, Sudan, kills 13

records.note: Tuesday afternoon September 8 supports same UTC date. Sudan Doctors Network reporting gives 13 dead/22 injured; Radio Tamazuj's authorities/eyewitnesses give 12 dead/20 injured outside courthouse. No reconciled final count retrieved. RSF attribution is a claim by monitoring groups/army-aligned authorities, not independently proven here.

changes.description: A drone strike near the Um Rawaba courthouse on the afternoon of September 8 killed at least 12 people, according to local reports; the Sudan Doctors Network reported 13. Sources blamed the RSF. The precise toll remains unreconciled.

key.title: Helicopter crash in Sarawak, Malaysia, kills five

records.note: BO-105 registration 9M-LLF, Flying Doctor Service, five aboard and deaths corroborated. Approximately 15:40 MYT September 8 equals 07:40 UTC; CAAM notification 15:58 is not the accident time. All remains recovered September 9.

key.title: Famine in Jebel Marra, Sudan, kills at least 20

records.note: Source says UP TO 20 dying EACH DAY from hunger/disease, an estimated mortality rate attributed to SLM-AW-aligned civil administration, not at least 20 identified deaths on September 8. Famine language is a local authority claim, not an IPC determination established here. No incident-level toll/date or second independent source record retrieved.

changes.description: On September 8, the SLM-AW-aligned civil administration reported famine conditions in Jebel Marra and nearby areas, estimating that up to 20 people were dying daily from hunger and disease. This was a reported mortality estimate, not a verified September 8 event toll.

key.title: Explosion at weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria, kills 14

records.note: Updated health-authority count 14 dead/11 injured supersedes initial SANA 3 dead/10 injured. Warehouse temporarily collected weapons and war remnants. Remove unestablished ongoing trapped-person claim; cause not assigned.

changes.description: An explosion at a temporary depot for weapons and war remnants near Sarmada, Idlib, on September 9 killed 14 people and injured 11, according to the local health department's updated account.

key.title: Explosion at Ritom hydroelectric plant in Switzerland kills two workers

records.note: Shortly after 09:30 CEST September 9 equals 07:30 UTC. Both workers died; avoid unsupported century-old adjective and unnecessary injury-to-death chronology.

changes.description: Two workers died after a fire and explosion at the old Ritom hydroelectric plant in Piotta, Ticino, shortly after 09:30 local time on September 9. Cantonal police described a serious workplace accident.

key.title: Record rain in central Japan kills one and injures 41

records.note: The fatal landslide occurred September 8 around 09:30 JST (00:30 UTC), not September 9, when death was confirmed after extraction/transport. Nagoya's 41 injuries belong to a separate regional rain-impact bulletin and do not establish this incident date. Narrow to the supported fatal event; omit superlative and unrelated transport/vehicle totals.

changes.title: Landslide at forest-road work site in Shizuoka kills one worker
changes.description: A landslide at a forest-road construction site in Kawanehoncho trapped a male worker on the morning of September 8. He was transported from the site the next day and confirmed dead.

key.title: Russian large-scale attack on Kyiv kills two

records.note: Matching two-dead/ten-injured Ukrinform bulletin is dated September 8, not 10; AFP corroborates early September 8 two-death count. September 10 reporting describes a gas-station strike with injuries and a separate regional death, not the claimed city toll. Likely a misdated preliminary duplicate of September 8 aggregate, but cannot assert identical victims without further evidence; do not publish or add twice.

key.title: Russian drone strike on shopping centre in Sumy kills three

records.note: The fatal strike was on the evening of September 9, not the September 10 publication date. Reuters explicitly records the governor retracting an initial three deaths to two; the police bulletin also gives two. Injuries increased from 14 to 23 in subsequent reporting. A repeat strike on September 10 must not inherit or duplicate the previous evening's deaths.

changes.title: Russian drone strike on shopping centre in Sumy kills two
changes.description: A Russian drone hit the parking area of the Manufactura shopping centre in Sumy on the evening of 9 September 2026, killing two people. An initial report of three deaths was corrected. Subsequent reporting put the number injured at 23.

key.title: Russian attacks on Mykolaiv kill four

records.note: Four deaths and 19 injuries are supported for attacks during September 9 and the night into September 10, not four established deaths on September 10 UTC. Ukrinform identifies two women and two men among the dead. The reporting interval crosses dates and individual fatal incident times were not established. The first two documents draw on the same police casualty account.

changes.description: Russian attacks on Mykolaiv during 9 September and the following night killed four people and injured 19, according to Ukrainian police. The figure covers a reporting interval rather than a single established UTC day.

key.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills woman in Borisoglebsk, Russia

records.note: Regional authorities reported a woman killed and two people injured in Borisoglebsk. The attack occurred overnight September 9-10 local time; the morning September 10 announcement is not an incident timestamp. Both sources rely on the regional governor. The UTC date remains unresolved, and attribution to Ukraine is the authorities' account.

changes.description: Regional authorities said an attack by Ukrainian drones overnight on 9-10 September killed a woman and injured two people in Borisoglebsk, Voronezh Oblast.

key.title: US strike on suspected drug boat in the Caribbean kills three

records.note: SOUTHCOM dates the operation to September 9; September 10 is the reporting date. Both publishers relay the same military announcement, not independent confirmation of the occupants' identities or trafficking allegations. The operation's exact time and the command's date time zone were not established, so the proposed September 9 date is not verified as UTC and the row remains withheld.

changes.description: U.S. Southern Command said its forces killed three people in a strike on a boat in the Caribbean on 9 September 2026. The military alleged that the vessel was involved in drug trafficking; the retrieved reports did not independently establish that allegation.

key.title: Cargo ship fire at Qingdao port kills 25

records.note: The fire began at 11:15 China Standard Time on September 10, or 03:15 UTC, during repairs at the Beihai shipyard in Qingdao. Twenty-five deaths were reported, with five injured and 12 reaching safety among 42 aboard. The cause was under investigation. Wire accounts share local-authority/Xinhua provenance; they are separate source documents, not independent casualty enumerations.

key.title: Hurricane Lowell linked to at least two deaths in Hawaii

records.note: Two deaths were linked to the storm, but September 10 is a report/update date. Hawaii News Now places the fatal Waimanalo tree incident at about 20:35 HST on Monday September 7, which is September 8 UTC. The other man's body was recovered on Kauai on September 9 after he went missing the previous day; recovery time does not establish death time. A single September 10 UTC casualty allocation is unsupported. Storm-surge attribution for the Kauai death was preliminary.

changes.description: Two deaths were linked to Hurricane Lowell in Hawaii: a man killed by a falling tree on Oahu and a man found dead on Kauai after being reported missing. The reports concern different incident and recovery dates, not two established deaths on 10 September.

key.title: Israeli strike kills family of four in northern Gaza

records.note: PCHR places the Ahmed family house strike at about 01:45 local time on September 10, equivalent to 22:45 UTC September 9. Reuters corroborates two parents and two children killed. The PCHR bulletin's headline total of ten covers several separate attacks during September 7-10 and must not be assigned to this household.

changes.description: An Israeli airstrike hit the Ahmed family's home near Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza at about 01:45 local time on 10 September 2026, or late 9 September UTC. Two parents and their two daughters were killed, according to Palestinian medical and human-rights reporting.

key.title: Church roof collapse in Vellore, India, kills three

records.note: Three deaths and 14 injuries are corroborated. The New Indian Express specifies approximately 16:30 IST on September 10, or 11:00 UTC, rather than an imprecise evening description. The News Minute links that report for the concreting details, so those two documents are not wholly independent. The cause remained under investigation.

changes.description: The roof of the under-construction CSI Zion Hill Church at Manjukrishnapuram near Thiruvalam in Vellore district collapsed during concreting at about 16:30 local time on 10 September 2026. Three workers were killed and 14 others were injured.

key.title: Tour bus crash in eastern Switzerland kills five

records.note: The crash occurred on Thursday September 10 at about 16:45 CEST, or 14:45 UTC, not the September 11 follow-up publication date. The corrected occupancy was 45 total: 44 adult passengers and the driver. Five died and 40 were injured; earlier reports of 49 aboard were superseded. The two AP links are successive reports from the same publisher, supplemented by NL Times.

changes.description: A Dutch tour bus crashed between Zernez and Susch in the Swiss canton of Graubunden at about 16:45 local time on 10 September 2026. Police reported five deaths and 40 injuries among the 44 adult passengers and driver.

key.title: Grenade attack on house in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka, kills two children

records.note: Newsfirst gives about 03:20 Sri Lanka time on September 11, equivalent to 21:50 UTC September 10. Retrieved local reports establish ages 11 and 17, not 10 and 14. Police suspected a mistaken-address attack connected with gang retaliation, not gang membership by the victims. Daily Mirror additionally reports two other children injured; Newsfirst highlights the father. The shorter description does not claim he was the only injured person. Motive remained a police account under investigation.

changes.description: A grenade attack on a house in Dehiwala killed two brothers aged 11 and 17 and injured their father at about 03:20 local time on 11 September 2026, or late 10 September UTC. Police said the attackers appeared to have targeted the wrong house in suspected gang retaliation.
